title: Shopping Offers
goal: Buy exactly the needed quantities at minimum cost using unit prices and reusable bundle offers.
strategy: Memoize each remaining-needs vector. Buying everything individually gives a valid baseline; apply a fitting useful bundle and recursively price the reduced vector, never buying extra items.
